title: От Луки 21 — Luke 21
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Эта бедная ___ положила больше всех, потому что все давали от своего избытка.
cases.translation: This poor widow put in more than all of them, because they all gave out of their abundance.
cases.explain: Вдова is the subject of «положила» (put in) — the subject of a verb stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Люди будут гибнуть от ___, и их будут уводить в плен во все народы.
cases.translation: People will fall by the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations.
cases.explain: The preposition от (by/from) always takes the genitive, so меч becomes меча.

cases.sentence: Всегда бодрствуйте и молитесь, чтобы вам оказаться в силах избежать всех этих ___.
cases.translation: Always watch and pray, so that you may have strength to escape all these calamities.
cases.explain: The verb избежать (to escape/avoid) governs the genitive, so бедствия becomes the genitive plural бедствий.

cases.sentence: Когда присутствующие заговорили о храме, о том, как он украшен прекрасными камнями и дарами, принесенными ___, Иисус сказал...
cases.translation: When some were talking about the temple, how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts brought to God, Jesus said...
cases.explain: The participle принесённые (brought) names the recipient in the dative — gifts brought to God, Богу.

cases.sentence: Иисус смотрел, как богатые клали свои дары в ___ храма.
cases.translation: Jesus watched as the rich were putting their gifts into the treasury of the temple.
cases.explain: The preposition в showing motion into a place takes the accusative, so сокровищница becomes сокровищницу.

cases.sentence: Вас будут ставить перед ___ и правителями.
cases.translation: You will be brought before kings and governors.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before/in front of) always takes the instrumental, so цари becomes царями.

cases.sentence: Будут происходить ужасные события и явятся великие знамения на ___.
cases.translation: There will be terrible events, and great signs will appear in the sky.
cases.explain: На marking a fixed location (not motion) takes the prepositional, so небо becomes небе.

cases.sentence: Каждый день Иисус учил в ___, а вечером шел на Масличную гору.
cases.translation: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and in the evening he went out to the Mount of Olives.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location (where, not motion into) takes the prepositional, so храм becomes храме.

reading.ru: Он увидел также и бедную вдову, которая бросила две медные монетки.
reading.question: What did Jesus notice the poor widow do?
options: She put in two small copper coins
She gave all her gold jewelry
She asked the rich for money
reading.correct: She put in two small copper coins
reading.explain: Jesus saw the poor widow cast in two small copper (brass) coins.

reading.ru: Наступит время, когда от всего, что вы здесь видите, не останется и камня на камне, все будет разрушено».
reading.question: What did Jesus predict about the temple buildings the disciples admired?
options: Not one stone would be left on another; everything would be destroyed
They would be rebuilt even more beautifully
They would be turned into a marketplace
reading.correct: Not one stone would be left on another; everything would be destroyed
reading.explain: Jesus said a time would come when not one stone would be left on another — all would be thrown down.

reading.ru: Смотрите, чтобы никто не обманул вас, потому что многие будут приходить под Моим именем, говоря, это Я, и время настало.
reading.question: What warning did Jesus give about people who would come in his name?
options: That many would come claiming to be him and deceive people
That they should trust anyone claiming to be him
That no one would ever come in his name
That only priests would recognize the true Messiah
reading.correct: That many would come claiming to be him and deceive people
reading.explain: Jesus warned that many would come in his name saying 'I am he' and that the time had come, and told his followers not to be deceived.

reading.ru: Будут сильные землетрясения, голод и эпидемии в разных местах, будут происходить ужасные события и явятся великие знамения на небе.
reading.question: What signs did Jesus say would accompany the coming troubles?
options: Earthquakes, famines, plagues, and great signs in the sky
A single earthquake in Jerusalem only
reading.correct: Earthquakes, famines, plagues, and great signs in the sky
reading.explain: Jesus described great earthquakes, famine, plagues, terrifying events, and great signs from heaven.

reading.ru: Вас будут предавать даже родители, братья, родственники и друзья, и некоторых из вас убьют.
reading.question: Who did Jesus say would betray his followers?
options: Even parents, siblings, relatives, and friends
No one — they would remain safe
reading.correct: Even parents, siblings, relatives, and friends
reading.explain: Jesus warned that even parents, brothers, relatives, and friends would betray them, and some would be put to death.

reading.ru: Тогда те, кто находится в Иудее, пусть бегут в горы, кто в городе, пусть бегут из него, кто вне города, пусть не входят в него, потому что это будет временем возмездия и исполнения всего написанного.
reading.question: What should people in Judea do when they see Jerusalem surrounded by armies?
options: Flee to the mountains rather than enter or stay in the city
Gather inside the city walls for safety
Go to the temple and pray
Ignore it and continue their daily routines
reading.correct: Flee to the mountains rather than enter or stay in the city
reading.explain: Jesus said those in Judea should flee to the mountains, those in the city should leave, and those outside should not enter it, since it would be a time of vengeance.

reading.ru: И тогда люди увидят Сына Человеческого, идущего на облаке силой и великой славой».
reading.question: How will people see the Son of Man, according to Jesus?
options: Coming on a cloud with power and great glory
reading.correct: Coming on a cloud with power and great glory
reading.explain: Jesus said people would see the Son of Man coming on a cloud with power and great glory.

reading.ru: Каждый день Иисус учил в храме, а вечером шел на Масличную гору и проводил там ночь.
reading.question: What was Jesus's daily routine according to the end of the chapter?
options: He taught in the temple by day and spent the night on the Mount of Olives
He slept in the temple every night
He stayed in Jerusalem's marketplace all day
He traveled to a different town each day
reading.correct: He taught in the temple by day and spent the night on the Mount of Olives
reading.explain: Every day Jesus taught in the temple, and each evening he went out to spend the night on the Mount of Olives.
